title: DraftExplanation
description: Per-hero decomposition of a draft's win probability (Coach Lab). Exact, not heuristic: the model is linear in log-odds, so dropping a hero — including their synergy/counter terms — is a real counterfactual. Served at POST /analysis/explain.

bracket.description: Rank band the response was scored with.

contributions.description: Sorted by absolute swing, biggest mover first.

hero_id.description: OpenDota id — the model's id space.

swing.description: Percentage points this hero adds to their OWN team's win probability vs an average pick. Leave-one-out counterfactuals; they do not sum to the total.
